question_record.context: A sequence of alerts that might be indicative of human-operated malicious activity was observed on this device `vnevado-win10b` and might lead to ransomware or other payloads installed on the device. question_record.question: Can you identify the AadUserId for the account linked to the deceptive sign-in attempt in this security incident?
solution: A potential human-operated malicious activity was detected on the account `kyleg`.
A sign-in attempt was detected using a deceptive user account with AadUserId `1d94aaf6-efe6-4e76-ad56-ffd7d1257bc1`. The attacker might be using this account to perform attack activities.

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_Name'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
